name: Report Formatting
description: Produces a data report structure with executive summary format, findings section template with chart-plus-interpretation pairs, methodology note, and appendix organization. Separates insight from supporting detail for maximum readability. Use when the user needs to structure a data-driven report for stakeholders, management, or publication. Do NOT use for single-chart formatting (use chart-formatting), infographic layout (use infographic-planning), or data narrative writing (use data-storytelling).
